name: COMML
description: iShares Diversified Commodity Swap UCITS ETF, USD-quoted LSE line (USD, LSE)

metadata.correction_note: Same fund/ISIN as assets/comm (GBP-quoted line); this is the USD-quoted LSE line, ticker ICOM. Deliberately excluded from universe.json's commodity/all groups by default since it is a near-duplicate exposure of assets/comm (same underlying swap, different quote currency) — including both would double-weight one economic bet in Top-N/risk-parity selection. Reference directly as assets/comml for FX-specific comparisons.
